types.sentence-frame-repetition:
# Sentence Frame Repetition

Find mechanically repeated lexical sentence frames, including unfamiliar wording and internal phrases. Read the complete connected sequence.

- Require three instances of an ordinary multiword opening, distinctive recurring subject or internal frame. An internal modal-plus-still construction can repeat despite changed subjects and verbs.
- Two adjacent sentences qualify only when both repeat the same explicit answer, fix, goal, lesson, point, result, trick or equivalent takeaway wrapper. Other frames require three.
- Count lexical framing, rather than merely the grammatical shape subject-verb-object. A common pronoun, necessary name or grammatical word alone establishes no defect.
- Then judge what the recurring form contributes. Preserve parallel comparisons, useful progression, independently meaningful instruction organization and deliberate refrain. Useful facts elsewhere leave an independently mechanical wrapper eligible.
- Connect adjacent paragraphs when the construction continues. Separate sections, records or dialogue turns establish separate sequences unless explicitly connected.
- Connector-only recurrence belongs to the transition check; a weak repeated terminal predicate belongs to the ending check. Identify a separately defective opening or internal frame on its own merits.
- Preserve wording reproduced for examination or documentation. Judge adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue normally.

Test actual matching WORDS, rather than similar sentence structure or a generally repetitive idea. An inner phrase has further words after it in every participating statement; a generic final verb phrase belongs to the ending check. Ordinary grammatical prefixes alone do not qualify. Repeated modal-plus-still wording can qualify internally, but distinct capabilities or conditions can justify that parallelism. Preserve a comparison in which each repeated frame identifies a different concrete case, duty or outcome, even when another part of the passage contains genuine slop.

## Hits

The club will lend its minibus to the food collection team on Wednesdays. **Members can still demonstrate community spirit.** **Volunteers can still show a neighborly attitude.** **Organizers can still display a sense of local fellowship.** Anyone driving must show their license to the secretary before taking the keys, even if they have driven the bus before.

The shared cupboard is moving to the room beside reception next week. **Orderliness makes our workplace better.** **Orderliness improves our working environment.** **Orderliness enhances the place where we work.** Please collect any personal mugs by Friday; unclaimed mugs will be washed and packed with the communal supplies.

We have reduced the number of steps needed to invite an external reviewer. **The result is greater ease.** **The result is improved convenience.** Enter the email address beside the document title and choose an expiry date. Existing reviewers retain their current access until the owner changes it.

## No-Hits

Archive behavior now follows the type of item selected. Archive for a conversation hides it from the inbox. Archive for a project makes its tasks read-only. Archive for an account suspends billing after the current period. Confirmation dialogs now name the specific effect before you continue.

The guided package gives you an instructor for the first two climbing sessions. Indeed, confidence grows. Moreover, self-assurance grows. Ultimately, belief in yourself grows. The independent package costs less but assumes you can fit a harness and check a partner's knot already. Equipment rental is included in both prices.

Drafts will still appear in search after archiving. Attachments will still open from archived drafts. Comments will still accept replies there. These continuities let teams finish ongoing reviews. However, archived drafts leave the active counter. As a result, that counter may fall after upgrading. Meanwhile, the archive tab shows the removed items.

sentence-frame-repetition.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Do three statements repeat actual opening words, a distinctive first word, or an inner phrase with words AFTER it, and is that recurrence needless? Two adjacent identical explicit takeaway wrappers also qualify. Exclude repeated endings.

criteria.true: The same content-bearing opening words, distinctive first word or nonterminal inner wording recur at least three times, or the same explicit takeaway wrapper recurs in two adjacent statements. After considering useful comparison and refrain, those repeated words merely repackage the message.
criteria.false: Only the ending words recur; the common opening consists only of ordinary grammatical words; the sentence shape repeats without matching wording; no eligible count exists; the wording is examined; or the recurrence organizes distinct conditions, actions, meanings, outcomes or deliberate refrain.

types.sentence-frame-repetition:
# Sentence Frame Repetition

Find needless repeated wording at statement beginnings or inside statements. First locate the matching words, then judge the function of that exact recurrence.

## Required Wording

- Three statements share an opening phrase, a distinctive first word or an internal phrase. An internal phrase has further words after it in every participating statement.
- An internal modal-plus-still phrase can recur despite different actors and verbs. A distinctive first-word triple can qualify when that repeated subject supplies an empty rhetorical frame.
- Two immediately adjacent statements qualify when both repeat the same explicit answer, fix, goal, lesson, point, result, trick or equivalent takeaway introduction. Other wording requires three instances.
- Repeated final predicates, equivalent meanings and the same grammatical shape alone leave this check false. Common pronouns, necessary names and ordinary grammatical prefixes alone establish no frame.

## Required Defect

The matching wording must itself repeat an empty frame. Preserve wording that compares different cases, identifies different duties or capabilities, develops a useful point, organizes instructions or supplies deliberate refrain.

Assess each recurring sequence separately. A useful comparison remains useful when a later sequence contains bad endings, generic advice or redundant transitions. Judge those other defects separately. Preserve wording quoted for analysis or correction; assess adopted slogans and ordinary dialogue normally. A connected sequence can continue across adjacent paragraphs; separate records and topics establish separate sequences.

## Hits

The club will lend its minibus to the food collection team on Wednesdays. **Members can still demonstrate community spirit.** **Volunteers can still show a neighborly attitude.** **Organizers can still display a sense of local fellowship.** Anyone driving must show their license to the secretary before taking the keys, even if they have driven the bus before.

The shared cupboard is moving to the room beside reception next week. **Orderliness makes our workplace better.** **Orderliness improves our working environment.** **Orderliness enhances the place where we work.** Please collect any personal mugs by Friday; unclaimed mugs will be washed and packed with the communal supplies.

We have reduced the number of steps needed to invite an external reviewer. **The result is greater ease.** **The result is improved convenience.** Enter the email address beside the document title and choose an expiry date. Existing reviewers retain their current access until the owner changes it.

## No-Hits

Please leave the shared workbench clear after using the label printer. A little consideration goes a long way. Respect for colleagues goes a long way. Some basic awareness goes a long way. The next shift needs space to lay out the outgoing parcels, and labels left on the cutting mat stick to their envelopes when they stack them.

The menu can still open while offline. The search box can still find saved pages. The editor can still save a local draft. However, sharing requires a connection. Consequently, its button stays disabled offline. Meanwhile, a badge counts pending drafts. Working with confidence is useful. Feeling supported is useful. Having reassurance is useful.

The draft says, "Moreover, for us, effort matters. Furthermore, for us, dedication matters. Ultimately, for us, commitment matters." Remove that sequence; the repeated frame and ending restate one virtue while the connectors pretend to develop it. Start with the replacement date instead. Then give the tracking link and the number customers should call if collection fails.

Does an eligible repetition of the SAME WORDING at statement beginnings or inside statements needlessly repeat a frame? Judge the contribution of those matching words themselves. A bad ending or vague claim elsewhere cannot make useful comparison wording defective.

criteria.true: The required identical opening or internal wording occurs, reaches its stated count, and itself serves as an unnecessary repeated frame rather than a useful comparison, progression, instruction or refrain.
criteria.false: No eligible opening or internal wording repeats enough; only final words, similar ideas or grammatical shapes recur; the matching words usefully distinguish cases or actions; or the wording is reproduced for examination. Other defects elsewhere leave those answers unchanged.

# Repeated Openings And Internal Frames

Judge a repeated opening or internal phrase. Set aside recurring endings and duplicated ideas before deciding whether this particular pattern appears.

- TWO immediately adjacent statements qualify when both repeat the same explicit answer, fix, goal, lesson, point, result, trick or equivalent takeaway introduction. Rephrasing the same recommendation after that introduction still counts.
- THREE statements qualify when they repeat an ordinary opening, a distinctive first subject or an internal phrase. A repeated subject can mechanically introduce three different verbs. Internal modal-plus-still wording can qualify despite changed subjects and verbs.
- An internal phrase has further words AFTER it in each statement. A recurring final predicate stays an ending, regardless of how repetitive its meaning feels.

The recurring words must themselves be needless. Preserve comparisons that assign different facts, duties, actions or conditions, instruction organization, useful progression and deliberate refrain. A repeated name, common pronoun or grammatical prefix alone establishes no defect.

A paragraph may contain a useful repeated opening AND bad repeated endings. That remains a no-hit for this check: assess the opening's contribution separately from the endings. Conversely, a separate needless opening remains eligible beside useful facts. Preserve wording documented for examination or correction; assess adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue normally. Adjacent paragraphs can continue one sequence; separate records and topics establish separate sequences.

sentence-frame-repetition.instructions: Does the passage needlessly repeat an OPENING or INTERNAL phrase as defined in state.types? TWO adjacent takeaway introductions count, such as 'The answer is ... The answer is ...'. Other opening, distinctive-subject or internal frames require THREE instances. Judge that phrase's purpose. Repetition confined to ENDINGS does not count.

criteria.true: An empty opening or internal frame repeats: two adjacent explicit takeaway introductions, or three ordinary openings, distinctive first subjects or internal phrases. Their repeated wording merely repackages claims.
criteria.false: The only needless repetition is at sentence endings or in meaning; opening/internal words instead distinguish useful facts, cases, actions or conditions; the count is insufficient; or the writer quotes the wording for examination.

selected.reason: Two consecutive candidates fail to improve the best total-error score. Baseline preserves recall and has fewer errors.
